description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering job title search parameters in an HRM system, including properties for sorting and filtering by activity status.

classes.name: JobTitleSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class used for encapsulating search filter parameters for job titles, including allowed sorting fields and an active-only filter.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with a default sort field 'jt.jobTitleName'.

methods.name: getActiveOnly
methods.description: Returns the filter status for active job titles (true, false, or null).

methods.name: setActiveOnly
methods.description: Sets the filter to include only active job titles if true; disables filtering if null.
